prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Caldera Wildfire Detection and Suppression Support System: advisory only; designated incident command retains authority; personnel accept/reject/verify; no autonomous dispatch, command/flight release, equipment/crew control. Mandatory: segmentation/time-sync/health-checks/audit-logging. Actors: local fire agencies, county emergency management, state wildland fire resources, aviation support units, cooperating public safety partners. Caldera Incident Command Portal (Emberhall): Duty Detection Officer (Orion), County Emergency Liaison, command staff; imagery/history/weather/maps/recommendations/status; above-threshold human triage; records advance/hold/dismiss reasons. Dismissals remain searchable for audit/model-improvement; no suppression-assignment/public-notification. North Lookout Camera Mast/South Lookout Camera Mast: overlapping/opposing coverage, hardened infrastructure, licensed-wireless backhaul/cellular degraded paths; North sends Thermal Spot Snippet. Horizon Ridge Drone Dock (Kestrel): launch/recovery/charging/shelter/health/security; maintenance threshold triggers Battery Swap Ticket. Drone Tasking Service manages approved requests/constraints/status, prepares verification for terrain/column-height/occlusion. Drone Pilot Operator reviews routes/dock/constraints, confirms launch safety/compliance. All observations: timestamp/georeference/equipment-status. Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine (Lantern): normalizes imagery/thermal/weather/context; timing/source/model/acknowledgment traceability. Smoke Classifier Module scores plumes, produces Ridge Shadow Mask; scores cannot declare fire. Thermal supports unless sequentially persistent/smoke-aligned. Officer compares imagery; may request camera pan/tilt/zoom. MesoWest Weather Fusion Node (Brindle): observations/forecasts/quality-checks, wind/humidity/temperature/stability; sends Wind Shift Bulletin. Confirmation requires persistent smoke/thermal plus independent-sensor/field-report corroboration or authorized-reviewer recorded visual judgment. Inconsistent/stale/single-low-confidence evidence stays triaged. Confirmed Ignition State enables suppression planning; contains location/confidence-basis/history/reviewer/coordination-posture. Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console (Marigold): aircraft/loading/mission coordination for Air Attack Supervisor (Redtail), Tanker Base Manager; operational records use full names. East Retardant Loading Pump/West Retardant Loading Pump: readiness/fault monitoring; East sends Retardant Batch Slip after metering/sealing. Crewline Mobile Tablet: Helitack Crew Leader receives only command-released confirmed

New part:
S079: The Air Attack Supervisor is responsible for deconflicting fixed-wing, rotary-wing, and uncrewed routes before the Drone Pilot Operator launches from the Horizon Ridge Drone Dock.
S080: The Drone Tasking Service shall not issue a launch task that conflicts with an active aviation lane maintained by the Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console.
S081: The Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console provides the aviation status view used by the Tanker Base Manager to sequence retardant aircraft availability.
S082: The Tanker Base Manager coordinates pump readiness for the East Retardant Loading Pump and the West Retardant Loading Pump before confirming that a tanker can accept an assignment.
S083: The VHF Radio Gateway Repeater is also known as Badger for voice traffic when a short call sign is needed during congested incident radio operations.
S084: The VHF Radio Gateway Repeater bridges command, air-to-ground, and county liaison talk paths when direct radio coverage is degraded by terrain.
S085: Radio bridging shall preserve the original speaker identity when the source channel provides it, because aviation supervisors use that identity to validate tasking and hazard reports.
S086: If a bridge path fails, the Caldera Incident Command Portal marks the affected radio route as impaired and requires manual acknowledgement by the Duty Detection Officer.
S087: Orion must verify that the impaired route has an alternate contact method before any new aviation coordination message is accepted.
S088: The County Emergency Liaison is the primary contact for county dispatch, road control, evacuation support, and local public safety notifications.
S089: The County Emergency Liaison sends the Drone Corridor Permit after local jurisdiction review is complete.
S090: County liaison procedures require that jurisdictional constraints be entered in the Caldera Incident Command Portal before the Drone Pilot Operator receives a route briefing.
S091: Temporary flight restrictions are requested through the established incident aviation chain and are represented internally by the Airspace Restricted State only after acceptance by the responsible authority.
S092: The Air Attack Supervisor reviews each temporary restriction against current fire perimeter intelligence from the Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine before approving a release of air assets.
S093: The MesoWest Weather Fusion Node supplies wind and visibility context used by aviation supervisors during route selection and holding-area planning.
S094: The North Lookout Camera Mast and the South Lookout Camera Mast provide observation context that helps the Air Attack Supervisor assess whether smoke columns may reduce route visibility.
S095: The South Lookout Camera Mast produces the Camera Cleaning Log as part of its maintenance reporting.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
